name: refuse-coincident-sphere-mesh
why: A correct solid whose mesh is a closed fragment of it: 4188.79 mm³ of B-rep tessellated as 727.70 mm³, watertight and one body, so every check that reads the mesh passed and the preview showed a sliver. The worker now compares the mesh's enclosed volume with the solid's, within what a 0.01 mm tessellation can account for, and refuses naming overlap as the fix. Goes red if the comparison is removed or the mesher is fixed — in which case this becomes a sphere that measures whole.

message_contains: Overlap them instead of letting them coincide
